title: Exactness of the fixed rational dual
statement: With w, its constructibility preservation hp, and localizedDual as in lem-coef-rational-verdier-localized-core, assume an ambient integral dual CommShift whose image of every distinguished triangle with integral-constructible vertices is distinguished. Then localizedDual has a CommShift and carries every distinguished triangle in the opposite rational constructible category to a distinguished rational triangle with this shift comparison. This asserts only exactness, without biduality or evaluation.

proof.text: Restrict the shift structure to the integral constructible subcategory using full faithfulness of its inclusion. Compare mapped triangles along the defining factorization, and use the given distinguished-triangle hypothesis and reflection by the inclusion.

The object and pure-tensor equations identify Q.op followed by the rational dual with the integral restricted dual followed by Q. Raw scalar localization is a categorical localization, and so is its opposite. Descend the shift through this factorization.
The localization has a calculus of fractions, hence its arrow functor is essentially surjective. Apply exactness descent through precomposition with this exact functor to the factorization.

        T ∈ distTriang (IntegralVerdier.Ambient l E X)ᵒᵖ →

          ((IntegralVerdier.dual l E X w.obj).map T.mor₂)
          ((IntegralVerdier.dual l E X w.obj).map T.mor₃ ≫
            (s.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app T.obj₁) ∈
          distTriang (IntegralVerdier.Ambient l E X)) :
    ∃ s : (localizedDual l E X w hp).CommShift ℤ,
      ∀ T : Triangle (sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X)ᵒᵖ,
        T ∈ distTriang (sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X)ᵒᵖ →
